corrections.text: The article quotes the arXiv preprint as saying: "a fidelity lower bound of 0.284 with 95% confidence while suppressing gate errors by 10× after syndrome post-selection." The preprint's abstract actually reads: "effectively suppressing gate error rates by 10× after syndrome post-selection, and yielding a state with a fidelity lower bound of 0.284 with 95% confidence." The clause order was reversed and the wording altered when it should have been quoted verbatim. The underlying figures (a 0.284 fidelity lower bound, 95% confidence, and 10x error suppression) are accurate.
